title: Tool invocation profiles, compact JSON arg format (ParamLite), and graded error code UX
creator: Avery Chen
description: Problem: Engineers frequently author tool/function contracts that are overly verbose (full JSON Schema) or brittle across SDK versions. Runtime validation surface returns large, uninterpretable errors unhelpful to app developers. We need a compact interchange format that: 1) reduces authoring friction for common patterns, 2) supports graceful compatibility with legacy tool manifests, 3) emits graded, actionable error messages and telemetry for validation failures.
proposal_summary: Introduce ParamLite: a compact, opinionated JSON arg manifest for tool/function calling. Build a runtime adapter that expands ParamLite to full schema for validation and also supports a backward-compatible legacy adapter. Add a graded error-code system (E1000 series) with remediation text and SDK hints. Surface partial validation hints during streaming responses to improve UX for long-running tool calls.
acceptance_criteria: ParamLite grammar documented in Confluence with examples for primitives, arrays, maps, and enum shorthands
Runtime implements ParamLite->full-schema expansion with unit tests (+ property tests for round-trip compatibility)
SDKs map runtime error codes to human-friendly messages and automated fix suggestions
Telemetry events for validation_failure emitted with severity and sample key paths
Backward-compatible adapter for existing tool manifests deployed behind a feature flag
End-to-end smoke test demonstrating streaming partial validation messages (chunked HTTP)
implementation_notes: ParamLite format: compact JSON where fields are declared using short type tokens and optional modifiers. Examples in PR and Confluence. Expanders live in runtime/schema/paramlite_expander.go. Graded errors: prefix E1xxx for validation; severity: info/warn/error. Include remediation string and SDK helper id for auto-fixes (SDK shows inline fix button in playground). For streaming, validation hints should be emitted as early as possible: e.g. when a required top-level field is missing, send a 'validation_hint' chunk before finishing model output. Use existing telemetry schema (telemetry.v2.validation) and add fields: code, severity, path, example_fix.
paramlite_examples: # A simple string param: {"title": "s"} -> expands to {"title": {"type": "string"}}
# Optional int with range: {"count": "i[0,100]?"} -> int, min 0, max 100, optional
error_model_and_codes: E1000: syntax/manifest parse failure - message + example snippet to fix
E1200: type-mismatch - includes expected/actual types and a short coercion hint
E1300: enum-invalid - suggests nearest valid value using fuzzy match
E1400: deprecated-field - warning severity, suggests modern alias and deprecation link
sdk_behavior: Map runtime errors to SDK exceptions with fields: code, severity, fix_suggestion
Expose a helper 'validateManifest(manifest, mode=paramlite)' that returns structured issues list
In playground/console show inline quick-fix actions for common E11xx/E12xx with one-click PR template
Provide opt-in streaming hints API on fetch.generate({stream: true, validationHints: true})
backcompat_strategy: Feature-flag ParamLite expansion at ingestion; default still accepts full JSON Schema
Build a compatibility adapter that converts common legacy patterns into ParamLite where possible
Deprecation timeline: warn users for 3 months (E1400) then auto-convert on opt-in
Telemetry to measure conversion success rate and common transformation failures
telemetry_and_alerting: Emit telemetry.v2.validation event with fields: code, severity, manifest_hash, path, customer_id
Create dashboard: Validation Failures by Code (top 50) and Conversion Success Rate
Alert when E1100 (required-field-missing) spikes > 5x baseline for a customer
risks_and_mitigations: Risk: ParamLite may be too opinionated for advanced schemas - Mitigation: passthrough to full-schema with an 'advanced' flag
Risk: Streaming validation hints may leak sensitive schema info - Mitigation: sanitize hint payloads and redact sample values
Risk: SDKs out of sync - Mitigation: ship server-side mapping first and provide SDK polyfills for 2 releases
checklist: Design doc reviewed by Research & Applied ML
Unit tests for expander and validator
E2E test for streaming hint chunking
Demo with Solutions Engineering and one pilot customer
